name: Merenye (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Merenye: a shield of yellow and green with a church and ears of grain, with green and white mantling and a scroll inscribed MERENYE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Merenye arms with mantling and scroll
